name: Bank of Maharashtra
about: Bank of Maharashtra is engaged in providing banking services. The Bank's segments include Treasury, Corporate/Wholesale Banking, Retail Banking and Other banking operations.[1]
keyPoints:
Revenue Breakup
Retail Banking: ~39% in FY24 vs ~35% in FY22 
Corporate/ Wholesale Banking: ~36% in FY24 vs ~30% in FY22 
Treasury: 21% in FY24 vs 32% in FY22
Other Operations: 4% in FY24 vs 3% in FY22 [1] [2]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 69.7% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 26.2%
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 38.0 days to 12.6 days
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
